implementation.mini: Pairing precedes target session. One camera QR scan button; inline QR hidden. Preview and copied URL are alternate actions. Paired management has explicit re-pair or local disconnect.
implementation.scan: wx.scanCode({onlyFromCamera:true,scanType:['qrCode']}); no needResult, private API, URL replay, browser proxy or authorization simulation. A decoded result triggers a status read and homepage scanner fallback, never pairing success.
implementation.control: Outer mini toggle controls only local entry, sidebar marker and route menu. Receive toggle changes only current node ClawBot enabled state. No implicit enable on pairing or browsing.
implementation.node: Both surfaces display native node name and host name; no credentials or cross-node binding handoff.
implementation.synchronization: Desktop checks status every 4s independently of provider long-poll; mini provider reads while foreground pairing and 5s status reads otherwise. Hidden/opt-out/context replacement cancels pending local reads without cancelling provider pairing.
implementation.lifecycle: Shared idempotent active QR attempt, absolute local 5-minute expiry, revision advancement for lifecycle and component restart. Expired credentials persist paused. Unpaired/no-target enable rejected. Legacy enabled-unpaired may generate pairing safely.
implementation.recovery: Same-account reauth preserves pending ledger. Different-account reauth with pending work requires explicit local removal. Old credential late errors cannot expire the replacement credential. Ambiguous delivery stays uncertain, never silently resent.
implementation.cleanup: Removed RC26 web-view confirmation route, owner entry, URL handoff helper and obsolete tests. Existing chat-bubble links and QR preview remain. No cloud experiment code found.
